# telnyx_sub_number_order (Data Source)

A sub number order: the part of a number order for one country and number type.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sub_number_order_id` (String) The sub number order.

### Read-Only

- `country_code` (String)
- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8901 datetime string denoting when the number order was created.
- `customer_reference` (String) A customer reference string for customer look ups.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_block_sub_number_order` (Boolean) True if the sub number order is a block sub number order
- `order_request_id` (String)
- `phone_number_type` (String)
- `phone_numbers` (Attributes List) The first 50 phone numbers in the sub number order, including their per-number regulatory requirement statuses. Only present when filter[include_phone_numbers]=true is used. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_numbers))
- `phone_numbers_count` (Number) The count of phone numbers in the number order.
- `record_type` (String)
- `regulatory_requirements` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regulatory_requirements))
- `requirements_met` (Boolean) True if all requirements are met for every phone number, false otherwise.
- `status` (String) The status of the order.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO 8901 datetime string for when the number order was updated.
- `user_id` (String)
